1.1: Look at her now—Jerusalem sittin' all alone, like a widow. Used to be full of folks, now she empty. She was that girl, a queen in the game. Now? Just another servant.
1.2: She cryin' all night long, tears runnin' down her cheeks. Used to have lovers, now ain't nobody comin' to wipe her face. Her so-called friends? Snakes. Turned on her quick.
1.3: Judah got dragged off, heavy and hurt. No rest, no peace. She livin' in strange lands now, and her enemies stay on her neck.
1.4: The roads to Zion? Quiet. Ain't nobody comin' to celebrate no more. The gates? Dead silent. Priests sighin', young girls broken. The whole city deep in bitterness.
1.5: Her enemies walkin' around like they run the place. Why? 'Cause the Lord let it happen—too many sins stacked up. Her kids? Snatched away by the enemy.
1.6: Zion's glow is gone. Her leaders out here movin' like starving deer—tired, weak, and runnin' scared.
1.7: Now that she's sufferin', she rememberin' the good ol' days—when she had joy, peace, all that. But when her people fell, ain't nobody came to help. The enemies laughed at her downfall.
1.8: Jerusalem messed up bad, and now she look a mess. Folks who used to respect her now turn their nose up. They seen her shame—now she just sighs and hides her face.
1.9: She ain't even think about where her choices would lead. Now her fall hit hard—no one there to catch her. She cryin' out, "Lord, look at me. I'm sufferin'. The enemy out here flexin'!"
1.10: The enemy done reached into her treasure chest, takin' all her goods. She even saw outsiders walk through the temple—folks You said ain't even supposed to step in there.
1.11: Her people hungry, tryna trade whatever they got for some bread. She pleadin', "Look, Lord. See what's happenin' to me. I'm bein' played and disrespected."
1.12: "Y'all just gon' walk by like this ain't nothin'? Stop and look—ever seen pain like this? The Lord came down hard on me. His anger hit different."
1.13: "He sent fire straight to my bones. Set me up like a trap. Now I'm stuck, drained, barely holdin' on."
1.14: "My sins? Heavy like a yoke on my neck. He wove 'em together, pressed 'em on me. My strength gone. He handed me over to folks I couldn't even fight off."
1.15: "He crushed all my warriors. Called a whole meeting just to stomp out my young men. God stepped on the daughter of Judah like grapes in a winepress."
1.16: "That's why I'm cryin'. Tears steady fallin'. The one who used to bring me comfort—gone. My children abandoned, 'cause the enemy won."
1.17: Zion stretchin' out her hands, beggin' for help—but nobody listenin'. God made sure her neighbors turned on her. Now Jerusalem gettin' treated like she unclean.
1.18: "God was right. I went against His Word. Y'all better listen—I'm hurtin'. My daughters, my sons? Gone. Caught up in captivity."
1.19: "I tried to call the ones I loved, but they ghosted me. Even the priests and elders died lookin' for food—just tryna survive."
1.20: "Lord, you see me. I'm stressed for real. Heart all twisted up. I know I rebelled, but outside got swords and inside feel like death."
1.21: "Folks hear me cryin', but nobody show up. My enemies? They smilin' like they won somethin'. But You did this, Lord. Bring that same energy to them."
1.22: "Let all they mess get put on blast, just like mine. Hit them with what You hit me with, 'cause I got a whole lotta sorrow and my heart barely hangin' on."

2.1: The Lord done covered Zion in a storm cloud of anger. He threw down Israel's glory from heaven to the dirt—like it was nothin'. Didn't even spare His own footstool when He got mad.
2.2: God ain't hold back—He wiped out every home in Jacob. Tore down Judah's strongholds in pure rage. He threw the kingdom down like trash and dragged the royal crew through the mud.
2.3: In His fury, He snatched away Israel's strength. Pulled back His right hand like, "Y'all on your own now." Then He lit up Jacob like wildfire—burned everything in sight.
2.4: He stood like He was the enemy. Bow drawn, hand steady. Took out the ones He used to love. Dropped that heat on Zion like a bomb.
2.5: Yeah, the Lord came through like an enemy for real. Knocked down Israel's whole setup. Palaces? Gone. Forts? Gone. Now it's just tears and heartbreak in Judah.
2.6: He bulldozed His own house like it was a backyard garden. Shut down the festivals, canceled the Sabbath. God ain't even check for the king or priest no more—He was done.
2.7: He turned His back on the altar, bounced on the sanctuary. Let the enemy break through the palace gates. They in there now, wildin' out in the temple like it's a block party.
2.8: God already had it planned—to destroy Zion's wall. He pulled out the measuring line like a contractor, but it was for demolition. Walls and defenses cried out like they knew they was next.
2.9: Her gates? Gone. Sunk straight into the dirt. The bars snapped off. Ain't no king, no princes—everybody scattered. God ain't speakin' through the prophets either. Silence.
2.10: The elders just sittin' on the ground in silence, tossin' dust on their heads, wrapped in sackcloth. The young girls got their heads down too—grief heavy in the air.
2.11: My eyes tired from cryin', my stomach turnin'. I'm sick over what happened to my people. Little kids out here faintin' in the streets like they got no chance.
2.12: They beggin' their mamas, "Where the food at? Where the drink?" But they passin' out in the streets, fallin' like wounded soldiers. Dying in their mama's arms.
2.13: What can I even say to you, Jerusalem? What example fits what you goin' through? Your hurt is wide like the ocean—who got the remedy for that?
2.14: Your so-called prophets been lyin'. Told you what you wanted to hear. Never checked you, never called out your mess. Just fed you fairy tales and delusions.
2.15: Folks walkin' by lookin' at you sideways, clappin' sarcastically. "This the 'joy of the whole earth'? This the 'perfect city'?" They laughin' now.
2.16: Your enemies got their mouths wide open, hatin' out loud. Grittin' teeth, talkin' slick: "We got her. This the day we been waitin' for."
2.17: The Lord followed through on what He said He'd do. He didn't flinch. Tore the place down without pity. Let your enemies have the last laugh. Lifted them up while you hit rock bottom.
2.18: Zion's people cried out to the Lord like, "Let the tears fall nonstop, day and night. Don't hold back. Don't rest."
2.19: "Get up. Cry through the night. Pour your heart out in front of God. Lift your hands and beg for your kids—starvin' and droppin' in every street corner."
2.20: "Lord, look! Look what's happenin'! Is this what You meant to do? Mothers eatin' their babies? Priests and prophets bein' killed in Your house?"
2.21: "The streets full of bodies—young and old. Girls and boys dead from the sword. You did this in Your anger, God. You didn't hold back."
2.22: "You called disaster like You was callin' folks to a party. But there was no escape. The ones I raised, the ones I loved? My enemies wiped 'em out."

3.1: I'm that man who seen pain up close—beat down by God's heavy hand.
3.2: He led me straight into darkness. Ain't no light, just shadows.
3.3: Day after day, He kept swingin' on me. Felt like I couldn't catch a break.
3.4: My body feel old. Skin cracked, bones hurtin'. He wore me out.
3.5: Surrounded me with bitterness, locked me in misery.
3.6: He sat me down in the dark, like I been dead and buried.
3.7: Built walls around me—I couldn't leave. Put chains on my soul.
3.8: I screamed, I begged—but He ain't pick up. My prayers ain't goin' nowhere.
3.9: Every path I tried? Blocked. Twisted. Like He made the road hard on purpose.
3.10: He came at me like a bear in the cut, or a lion ready to pounce.
3.11: Snatched me off my path, tore me apart. Left me feelin' empty.
3.12: He pulled His bow, aimed right at me—like I was the target.
3.13: His arrows hit deep. Pierced through me like He was settin' a message.
3.14: Now folks laugh at me. I'm the joke, the meme, the group chat topic.
3.15: He filled me with bitterness—made me drink pain like it was my medicine.
3.16: Broke my teeth on gravel. Rubbed my face in ashes.
3.17: Peace? Don't even know her no more. Joy? Can't remember the last time.
3.18: I said to myself, "It's over. My strength and my hope died today."
3.19: Lord, remember how bad it's been. That bitterness, that sorrow—it stay in my chest.
3.20: My soul still feelin' it. I stay sunk low.
3.21: But I gotta pull somethin' up out my memory—this one thing keeps me hangin' on:
3.22: We ain't been wiped out completely 'cause God still got mercy. His love don't run dry.
3.23: New mercies show up every single morning. Your faithfulness? Solid.
3.24: Deep in my soul I say, "God is all I got, so I'ma keep hopin' in Him."
3.25: The Lord good to them who wait on Him, who chase after Him with their whole heart.
3.26: It's a blessing to wait quiet, even when it's hard—trustin' God gon' come through.
3.27: Better to carry some weight while you young—learn the lesson early.
3.28: Sit in that silence. Don't complain. If God handed it to you, there's a reason.
3.29: Put your face in the dirt—humble yourself. You might still find some hope down there.
3.30: If you get slapped, take it. If folks talk down on you, endure it. God seein' all of it.
3.31: The Lord ain't gon' leave you forever.
3.32: He might let you hurt for a season, but His compassion still deep. Real deep.
3.33: God don't enjoy watchin' us suffer. That ain't His heart.
3.34: He ain't about crushin' folks for no reason, or abusin' power over prisoners.
3.35: He don't like it when people block justice, or cheat somebody outta their rights.
3.36: Tryin' to twist someone's case? That ain't it. God ain't with that.
3.37: Who can make somethin' happen if God ain't co-signed it?
3.38: Ain't it both good and bad that come from the Most High's mouth?
3.39: So why you mad at life when you the one that messed up? Own your sins.
3.40: Let's check ourselves. Let's turn back to God while we still got time.
3.41: Lift our hearts and hands to the One in heaven. No shame in surrender.
3.42: We rebelled. We crossed the line. And You ain't let it slide.
3.43: You chased us down with Your anger. Cut us off. No mercy that time.
3.44: You blocked us off with a thick cloud. Prayers couldn't even get through.
3.45: Now the nations look at us like trash—refuse. Dirt under their feet.
3.46: Our enemies talk wild. Mouths open wide.
3.47: Fear everywhere. Traps everywhere. All we see is destruction.
3.48: My eyes stay leakin', cryin' rivers for my people.
3.49: I can't stop. The tears don't pause.
3.50: Not till God looks down from heaven and sees what's goin' on.
3.51: What I see hurt my soul. Especially what's happened to my sisters in the city.
3.52: My enemies hunted me like I was a bird, for nothin'.
3.53: Threw me in a pit. Tried to bury me alive. Tossed rocks on top.
3.54: Water closed in over me. I said, "This it. I'm done."
3.55: But I called on Your name, Lord—from the bottom. From the pit.
3.56: You heard me cryin'. You ain't shut Your ears.
3.57: When I called, You came close. You said, "Don't be scared."
3.58: Lord, You fought for me. You saved my life.
3.59: You seen what they did to me. You know how they wronged me. Handle it.
3.60: You saw all the shade, all the schemes they ran.
3.61: You heard their slick talk, Lord. You peeped the whispers and the hate.
3.62: The way they talked, the things they plotted—it was constant.
3.63: They mock me when I sit, when I stand. I'm their lil' joke now.
3.64: Lord, pay 'em back for all they done. Let them reap what they sowed.
3.65: Give 'em a heart that can't see the truth. Let Your judgment rest on 'em.
3.66: In Your anger, chase 'em down. Wipe 'em out from under heaven.

4.1: Look at that—gold gone dull. The fine stuff? Tarnished. The stones from God's house? Scattered like trash on the corners.
4.2: Zion's sons used to shine like pure gold. Now folks treat 'em like clay pots—cheap and cracked, like they ain't nothin' special.
4.3: Even wild jackals nurse their babies. But our people? Cold. Actin' heartless like ostriches in the desert—don't even care for they own.
4.4: Babies out here dry-mouthed, tongue stuck to the roof from thirst. Kids cryin' for food, but nobody breakin' bread for them.
4.5: Folks who used to eat luxury meals? Now they sittin' on sidewalks lookin' lost. Ones raised in velvet robes? Huggin' piles of ash.
4.6: Zion's punishment hit harder than Sodom's. At least Sodom got wiped quick. No one was left to even reach for help.
4.7: Her Nazirites used to glow—skin bright like snow and milk, cheeks red like rubies, faces like sapphires.
4.8: Now they look like soot—ashy, unrecognizable. Skin stuck to bones, bodies dried up like brittle wood.
4.9: Better to die by the sword than waste away from hunger. At least that's fast. Hunger makes you slowly disappear.
4.10: Women once full of love got pushed so far, they cooked their own kids just to survive. That's how deep the destruction hit.
4.11: The Lord ain't hold back. His anger came down like wildfire. Burned through Zion to the foundation.
4.12: The kings of the world ain't believe it. Nobody thought enemies could walk through Jerusalem's gates—but they did.
4.13: And why? 'Cause the prophets were dirty. The priests were wildin'. They spilled innocent blood and led the people wrong.
4.14: Now they out here wanderin' blind, blood on them, lookin' unclean. Folks don't even wanna touch their clothes.
4.15: People shout, "Back up! Don't come near! You unclean!" They ran, they hid—but even the other nations said, "Y'all can't stay here."
4.16: God turned His face away. He wasn't tryna hear it. The people lost respect for the priests, didn't care about the elders.
4.17: We kept watchin' the horizon, hopin' for help. Waited on nations that never came through. Just empty promises.
4.18: They followed our every move. Streets weren't safe. We knew the end was near. Time was up.
4.19: Our enemies chased us like eagles—fast, fierce. Got us on the mountains, stalked us in the wilderness.
4.20: The one we thought was our lifeline, the anointed one, even he got caught. We said, "We'll live safe under his protection"—but that shadow vanished too.
4.21: Go ahead and laugh now, Edom. You next. That cup of judgment? You gon' drink it too. And you gon' be exposed—stripped bare.
4.22: But Zion, your time of payin' is just about done. No more exile. But Edom? Oh, He still got somethin' for you. Your dirt gon' get aired out.

5.1: Lord, please remember what happened to us. Look at the shame we carry—see us for real.
5.2: Everything that was ours—our land, our homes—got taken over by outsiders. Strangers livin' in our inheritance.
5.3: We like orphans now. No protection. Our mamas feel like widows—left alone.
5.4: We gotta pay just to get water to drink. Even firewood cost us somethin'.
5.5: We can't catch a break. They stay on our backs. We work hard, but we don't get no rest.
5.6: We been out here beggin' Egypt and Assyria just to put some bread on the table.
5.7: Our fathers messed up and now they gone. But we the ones payin' the price.
5.8: Servants runnin' things now. And ain't nobody showin' up to rescue us.
5.9: We gotta risk our lives just to find food. The wilderness got swords waitin' on us.
5.10: Our skin feel like it's burnin' up—hot like an oven. Famine fever got us weak.
5.11: Our women been violated in Zion. Our daughters in Judah ain't safe no more.
5.12: The princes got hanged by their hands. Elders? Ain't nobody respectin' them.
5.13: The young men workin' like slaves at the grindstone. Little boys bucklin' under wood loads.
5.14: The elders don't even sit at the gate no more. The young ones? The music done stopped.
5.15: Ain't no joy in our hearts. The party's over. Our dance done turned into a funeral.
5.16: The crown done fell off our head. We lost our shine. All 'cause we sinned. This pain? We earned it.
5.17: Our hearts heavy because of all this. Our eyes stay cloudy with tears.
5.18: Mount Zion, once so holy, now deserted—foxes just runnin' around like they own it.
5.19: But You, Lord, You still on the throne. Always have been. Always will be.
5.20: So why You feel so far off? Like You forgot about us? Why You lettin' it drag on like this?
5.21: Turn us back to You, Lord. We ready. We want to be restored. Bring us back to how it used to be.
5.22: Unless… You done really turned Your back. Unless Your anger still burnin'. But Lord… don't leave us like this.
